item.title: Morgan Stanley listed staked ETH and SOL ETPs on NYSE Arca on July 28, each charging a 0.14% expense ratio.
BlackRock, Fidelity, Franklin Templeton and Goldman Sachs backed the Senate CLARITY Act on July 28 as the passage window closes August 10.
Six U.S. federal agencies missed the July 18 GENIUS Act deadline to finalize stablecoin regulations; OCC comment period runs to August 21.
Japan's National Diet reclassified crypto as financial products under the FIEA on July 15, capping gains tax at a flat 20% from 2028.
A revised CLARITY Act text emerged July 22, making an earlier ethics provision temporary as negotiators push toward a Senate floor vote.
The SEC set July 2026 targets for three rulemaking proposals covering token offerings, broker-dealer custody, and crypto market structure.
California's Digital Financial Assets Law took effect July 1, imposing $100,000 daily fines on unlicensed crypto platforms serving state residents.
MiCA's full enforcement period began July 1, closing the EU transition window for unlicensed crypto-asset service providers.
North Korea's Lazarus Group took $609 million in a 17-day April 2026 window, representing roughly 55% of all H1 2026 crypto losses.
Crypto exploit losses in H1 2026 hit an all-time record of $1.1 billion across 212 incidents; July alone has seen $97 million in 14 hacks.
An exploit of an AFX-powered bridge on Arbitrum drained $24.15 million in USDC on July 22; Blockaid confirmed the breach at 21:30 UTC.
Citadel Securities invested $400 million in Crypto.com at a $20 billion valuation in July 2026, expanding regulated institutional crypto infrastructure.
The OCC conditionally approved national trust bank charters for Circle and Paxos in December 2025 under the GENIUS Act implementation framework.
